# Commands

Every `artmind query` command, and the read-only `artmind db` commands, with their options. Always pass `--compact`; pass `--shape brief` to the retrieval commands.

- `artmind query assets` --domain --kind --like --stale --limit --compact  
  What a domain already answers: saved views, topic pages, insight findings and summary coverage.
- `artmind query catalogue` --domain --part --names --compact  
  What the system knows about a domain: classes, relations, documents, names, stores, time, health.
- `artmind query chunks` --domain --idList --expand --asOf --shape --compact  
  Fetch chunk text by exact id (the doc_sources / evidence ids other commands return).
- `artmind query document-history` --domain --documentName --compact  
  What a document's ingested versions asserted: current vs history observations.
- `artmind query domains-overview` --compact  
  Per-domain routing summary: doc names/counts, entity counts, top classes.
- `artmind query entity-context` --domain --entityId --includeChunks --query --relType --maxConnections --maxListItems --shape --compact  
  Entity properties + one-hop relationships + source chunk text in one call.
- `artmind query entity-history` --domain --entityId --key --name --entityClass --asOf --property --compact  
  Every observation behind one entity, ordered by fact-level valid time.
- `artmind query entity-resolve` --domain --topK --compact <reference>  
  Resolve a name fragment or description to canonical graph entities (exact name first, then fulltext + vector via RRF).
- `artmind query graph conflicts` --domain --entityId --entityName --status --compact  
  List materialized Conflict nodes scoped to the given domains.
- `artmind query graph entity-listing` --domain --nameFilter --countAll --maxNames --compact  
  Return entity names grouped by label/type.
- `artmind query graph filing-listing` --domain --project --area --tag --asOf --compact  
  List Documents filtered by filing taxonomy (project, area, tags, domain).
- `artmind query graph hierarchy` --domain --entityId --entityName --entityClass --childOf --parentOf --direction --maxDepth --limit --nodeClass --compact <question>  
  Bounded transitive walk (descendants or ancestors) along chosen rel types.
- `artmind query graph metadata` --domain --compact  
  Return graph schema metadata (labels, properties, relationship types).
- `artmind query graph pattern1` --domain --entityClass --limit --shape --compact <question>  
  List entities of a class. `--shape brief`: id, name, class, one-line description per row.
- `artmind query graph pattern10` --domain --documentName --includeHistory --asOf --limit --offset --compact <question>  
  Retrieve all text chunks for a named document (current only, or with history).
- `artmind query graph pattern2` --domain --entityNameList --entityIdList --maxDocSources --maxSourceDocuments --shape --compact <question>  
  Info on one or more named entities. `--shape brief`: id, name, class, one-line description, evidence ids.
- `artmind query graph pattern3` --domain --entityNameList --entityIdList --maxConnections --maxDocSources --maxSourceDocuments --compact <question>  
  Entity + lightweight relationship summary.
- `artmind query graph pattern4` --domain --entityClass --entityName --entityId --maxConnections --maxListItems --maxDocSources --maxSourceDocuments --compact <question>  
  Entity + full neighborhood.
- `artmind query graph pattern5` --domain --entityClass1 --entityClass2 --entityName1 --entityName2 --entityId1 --entityId2 --mode --compact <question>  
  Paths between two entities (shortest or all within depth 5).
- `artmind query graph pattern6` --domain --entityName1 --entityName2 --entityId1 --entityId2 --compact <question>  
  Direct relationships between two entities.
- `artmind query graph pattern7` --domain --searchTerm --limit --shape --compact <question>  
  Search entities by name or description fragment. `--shape brief`: id, name, class, one-line description, documents.
- `artmind query graph pattern8` --domain --entityClass --entityName --entityId --limit --offset --compact <question>  
  Entities of class X connected to entity Y.
- `artmind query graph pattern9` --domain --entityClass --topN --degreeMode --compact <question>  
  Top-N entities of a class by connection count.
- `artmind query graph structural-metadata` --domain --maxNames --compact  
  Return focused structural metadata (Document, DocChunk, UserChat, Entity counts and relationships).
- `artmind query graph text2cypher` --domain --compact --dryRun --maxRows <question>  
  Generate and execute a Cypher query from a natural-language question (LLM-powered).
- `artmind query graph timeline` --domain --from --to --compact  
  Every entity of a `kind: occurrent` class in these domains, ordered by valid_from.
- `artmind query insights list` --domain --detector --kind --new --limit --compact  
  Top findings by score, with captions and the subjects' _ids for grounding.
- `artmind query insights show` --domain --shape --compact <key>  
  One finding with its full stats and card (the evidence behind a caption).
- `artmind query page` --from --rows --list --compact <handle>  
  Show more rows of a result that ARTMIND_OUTPUT_BUDGET cut (its `handle` and `next` say how).
- `artmind query plan` --domain --execute --classifier --previous --exclude --compact <question>  
  Plan the retrieval for a question: intent, slots, domains, saved view, route and ready-to-run steps.
- `artmind query resolve-key` --domain --column --table --topK --compact <phrase>  
  Resolve a free-text value to a canonical column value and/or graph entity.
- `artmind query run` --domain --exclude --previous --classifier --plan --maxSteps --deadline --each --maxItems --compact <question>  
  Plan a question and execute the plan's program in process: one evidence bundle (P3).
- `artmind query survey` --domain --topDocs --passages --shape --passageDocs --gistDocs --expand --compact <question>  
  Documents for a question that spans documents: document summaries, chunk summaries and passages, fused.
- `artmind query text2sql` --domain --asOf --dryRun --compact <question>  
  Natural language to read-only DuckDB SQL against the structured store, then execute it.
- `artmind query topics list` --domain --stale --compact  
  Every topic page with its domains, build date, anchor, source count and staleness.
- `artmind query topics show` --compact <slug>  
  One topic page: its body (with footnotes), sources, checks and staleness.
- `artmind query vector-text` --domain --topK --context --asOf --shape --compact <question>  
  Hybrid search over passages: vector + keyword (RRF), grouped into parent chunks.
- `artmind query views list` --domain --compact  
  The view catalogue: name, summary, example questions, parameters. Invalid views are reported, not hidden.
- `artmind query views run` --domain --param --render --compact <name>  
  Run a saved view. status is ok | needs_disambiguation (ask the user, rerun with @<_id>) | no_match.
- `artmind query views show` --compact <name>  
  The full view.yaml plus the view's SKILL.md guidance (read it before running the view).

## Read-only `artmind db`

- `artmind db list` --domain --compact  
  List registered structured tables, optionally domain-scoped.
- `artmind db review` --domain --compact  
  List every table classification still awaiting human adjudication.
- `artmind db schema` <table> --domain --compact  
  Show columns/types (+ profiles/mappings once populated) — the context an LLM needs to write SQL.
- `artmind db sql` <sql> --compact  
  Run raw read-only SQL against the structured store — no LLM (the independent-query guarantee).
- `artmind db timeline` <table> --domain --asOf --compact  
  Point-in-time query over a temporal (SCD-2) table's captured history.
